controls.prediction_to_refine_and_seal: Omit a signed mixed coherent term or substitute a scalar multiple of the norm moment for the energy moment; detect the selected exact discrepancy.
Omit cell escape or one flavor sector, or claim a weighted upper for every input; source/moment or quantifier checks must reject that variant.
Replace the real polar filter by real-time hopping or copy a different field own-cloud overlap; do not accept that as the proved map/family certificate.
Restrict the proper partition test to balanced fragments; detect loss of the actual worst channel.
Drop a flavor feasibility cut, weight-changing intermediate or parity restriction; detect an invalid target/proper/flavor assertion.
Treat the success branch as the whole source or transfer the earlier arrival probability/old carbon action; source/Gram/probability checks must refuse it.
Vary parameters inside the sufficient region: the actual margin must follow its parameter formula rather than stay at the benchmark constant.
An integer-time attaining schedule and a simple ramp are distinct full-energy checks; retain endpoint conventions.
A signed finite ramp cannot bypass the proved lower; check a concrete nonmonotone example independently.
A discrete-mode recurrence or settled local mean must not be mistaken for zero full-continuum excess.
An unspecified static displaced incoming Fock vacuum or unpriced additional control violates the declared source/control premise; retain the valid free-vacuum supplied-drive case.

policy: Predictions refined and sealed before execution; a control that does not break as predicted is retained and reported.
